verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents a cardholder disputes capability to submit and manage debit card disputes in line with Reg E and card network requirements, so it directly addresses the card-dispute core. The evidence is a single summary line, though. The ACH evidence covers only returns of originated transfers and status/return codes, not consumer ACH dispute handling. Account locking during investigations is a related control, not dispute tooling. Missing for 10: documented Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit mechanics, ACH (unauthorized-debit) dispute workflow, defined ops responsibilities and dispute tooling details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, card and ACH disputes are handled properly — Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit mechanics, and my operational responsibilities documented and tooled

citations.quote: Submit and manage debit card disputes in line with Regulation E (Reg E) and card network requirements.
